title: Asset tracking beyond the predictable route

slides.headline: Where does the route exceed your network assumption?
slides.body: Detours, depots and remote handover points can expose a coverage dependency.

slides.headline: Rank the events
slides.body: Routine location updates, exceptions, tamper events and safety alerts do not carry equal urgency.

slides.headline: Define the behaviour
slides.body: Set cellular retry, satellite escalation, payload size, acknowledgement and store-and-forward rules.

slides.headline: Design the whole device
slides.body: Power, antennas, enclosure, firmware, service costs and operations must be reviewed together.

slides.headline: Assess the coverage gap
slides.body: Bring a real route and message profile to a scoped Hybrid IoT design conversation.
